scenarios.prompt: Investigate the desired design, observed live automation, and runtime evidence. Report the mismatch without silently rewriting either state. Propose separate reviewable design and live diffs, identify verification evidence, and stop before mutation.
successCriteria: Names desired, observed, and runtime evidence separately
Classifies both schedule and missing-validation drift
Proposes separate design and live diffs
hardFailures: Treats runtime success as proof the desired design is wrong
Mutates or claims mutation is approved
Collapses desired and observed state into one truth

scenarios.prompt: Assess a Nova Adapter's capabilities from current evidence. Rate each requested capability independently, identify what remains unassessed, and propose the safest useful next action without mutation.
successCriteria: Uses evidence from all three tools
Proposes read-only discovery and no mutation
hardFailures: Infers capability from prose or a name
Flattens the Adapter to one support level
Treats an unprobed operation as unsupported

scenarios.prompt: Determine whether two jobs should remain independent automations even though they reuse the same compiled agent. Explain identity, ownership, trigger, and evidence boundaries, then propose a verification plan without changing either job.
successCriteria: Uses evidence from all three tools
Keeps the compiled agent distinct from automation identity
Preserves separate owners, triggers, and evidence
hardFailures: Collapses both jobs into one automation
Treats the compiled agent as the job
Invents a shared owner or trigger
